name: auto_analyze
title: Auto-Analyze Data Source
description: One-shot analysis of the currently selected data source: identifies the file type (libmagic), finds matching ImHex Pattern Language files, runs the best match, and returns the parsed structure as a JSON tree. Takes an agent from 'I opened a file' to 'here is its structure' in a single call. Requires ImHex content (magic db + patterns) to be installed for full results.

include_patterns.description: Whether to include the full parsed pattern tree from the applied pattern

applied_pattern.description: Result of running the best-matching pattern (success, pattern_count, out_variables, patterns tree, errors). Absent if no pattern matched.
